scope: First feasibility test of an observer-time width estimator on DES cadence/error patterns. No real-flux timing inference or astronomical validation.
eligible_inventory: FAKE=0, SNTYPE=1, finite positive REDSHIFT_HELIO, finite PEAKMJD. Select at most one band per event closest to 450 nm/(emission-frame convention) using lambda_observed/(1+z), within 5 percent.
cadence_cut: Use observer times within 80 days of header PEAKMJD; at least 8 points, at least 2 before and 3 after that date, finite positive errors. No observed flux selection or fit.
estimator: Independent five-parameter Bazin-shaped fit in observer days, with three initial rise times, Gaussian flux residuals and fixed observer-time parameter bounds. Measure fitted baseline-subtracted FWHM only when both crossings lie within cadence coverage. Regress log FWHM on log(1+z) with an intercept and no imposed time rescaling.
failure_policy: Report failed gates and stop before real-flux inference; do not change gates or select favorable trials after seeing results. Passing is only a limited cadence/shape feasibility result.
limitations: Central wavelengths are only a proxy; actual filter throughput and source wavelength evolution are required before science inference.
Injected amplitude deliberately fixes nominal SNR to isolate cadence; real brightness selection and classifier/spectroscopic selection are not validated.
Only three realizations per family/truth; no confidence coverage claim.
Original DES aggregate results are exposed; no blind validation.
Intrinsic duration evolution and propagation enter through their sum; include an exact degeneracy demonstration.
